item.title: My Most Unusual Encounter With An Actor (LA, the Mob and Acting)
item.description: One day in the mid-80s, I received a visit from a man wanting to join my repertory company for film and television. He had never acted before, and after perusing what was on offer in the local trade papers, had come to the conclusion that what I was offering gave him the best shot of establishing himself as an actor.
